Residues in the interface between HyHEL-63 and HEL were substituted with alanine. Alanine substitution at HEL position K96 resulted in the greatest reduction in affinity. Substitution at HEL positions Y20 and K97 also greatly reduced binding and positions R21, W63, L75 and D101 had smaller effects. Substitution at positions W62, T89, N93, and S100 had very little effect.; Unmapped quantitative response: association constant KA 0.00036 1/nM

interactions.assay: surface plasmon resonance (SPR) · association constant KA
interactions.note: The epitope specific Fab HyHEL-63 bound to immobilized HEL. Single alanine substitution of  epitopic residue K97A decreased the apparent KA 370-fold to 9.4 x 10<sup>5</sup> M^-1. Substitution Y20A also decreased the apparent KA to 1.4 x 10<sup>6</sup> M^-1, whereas mutants R21A, W63A and D101A had minor effects. Residues Y20 and K97 are located in the center of the interface and completely or almost completely buried upon complex formation.; Unmapped quantitative response: association constant KA 0.36 1/nM
